newsitem.title: USA: United Meridian Lion A-3 well tests oil, gas.
newsitem.headline: United Meridian Lion A-3 well tests oil, gas.

text.p: United Meridian Corp said Monday its Lion A-3 development/exploratory well on Block CI-11 off the Ivory Coast tested at 11,960 barrels of oil and 42 million cubic feet of natural gas per day from three zones.
Two of the zones are new reservoir discoveries in shallower sands, United said.

Initial production of the dual oil well is estimated at 4,000 barrels per day, the company said. Following tie-in to existing production facilities, United said it expects total oil production in the Lion field to increase to about 19,000 barrels per day.

United Meridian, the operator, holds a 25 percent working interest in Block CI-11. Partners in the A-3 well include PETROCI, the national oil company of Cote d'Ivoire (20 percent), International Finance Corp (23 percent), Seagull Energy Corp (16 percent), and Pluspetrol SA (16 percent).

On Block B offshore Equatorial Guinea, United Meridian said it and its partner, Mobil Corp have reached a production level in excess of 40,000 barrels per day from five wells in the Qua Iboe formation in the Zafiro field after starting production on August 25.
Two additional wells are scheduled to be connected to the floating production storage and offloading vessel before year end, completing Phase I of the Zafiro field development, the company said.

Phase II of the project is underway, and three wells have been drilled and completed and are awaiting tie-in to the vessel. It said Phase II will include additional wells and facilities in 1997. United Meridian holds a 25 percent interest in Block B. Mobil is the operator and holds a 75 percent interest.

Ten miles to the southwest of Zafiro on Block B, United Meridian said it and Mobil drilled an unsuccessful well on the East Malaquita exploratory prospect. The well targeted a deeper Isongo formation which was found to contain no reservoir. The rig has moved to the Rubi prospect, which will test the Qua Iboe formation downdip on the southeast flank of the Zafiro field, plus a deeper Qua Iboe objective.
